SELECT f.channel_code, f.channel_id, c.channel_name, c.channel_group, c.legacy_channel_code, s.store_id, count(*) n, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, sum(net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, max(etl_loaded_at) ld
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id=f.channel_id LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.channel_code<>'ST' OR f.channel_id IS NULL OR s.store_id>=900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,6

SELECT f.channel_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 OR f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, sum(CASE WHEN f.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noprod
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-11-03' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(f.quantity) units, count(DISTINCT f.product_key) versions
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-11-03' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY p.sku),
r AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(rl.refund_net) ref_net, sum(rl.quantity_returned) ref_units, count(*) nret, count(DISTINCT rl.return_line_id) dret
  FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-11-03' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY p.sku),
n AS (SELECT sku, max(product_name) nm, count(DISTINCT product_name) nn, max(category) cat FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku)
SELECT s.sku, n.nm, n.nn, n.cat, s.gross_net, coalesce(r.ref_net,0) ref_net, s.gross_net-coalesce(r.ref_net,0) net_of_ret, s.units, coalesce(r.ref_units,0) ru, s.versions, r.nret, r.dret
FROM s JOIN n USING(sku) LEFT JOIN r USING(sku) ORDER BY s.gross_net DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT 'ret_total' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, sum(refund_net) v, min(return_date) mn, max(return_date) mx FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date>=DATE '2025-11-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_ret', count(*), count(DISTINCT rl.return_line_id), sum(rl.refund_net), min(rl.return_date), max(rl.return_date) FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_ret_pre_sale', count(*), 0, sum(rl.refund_net), min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date) FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date<DATE '2025-11-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_nomatch', count(*), 0, sum(refund_net), NULL, NULL FROM fact_return_line rl WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id)

SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact' k, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) v, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_total', count(*), sum(net_amount), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM stg_sales_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_web_ge_mig', count(*), sum(net_amount), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE channel_id IN (2,3)
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_web_lt_mig_ts', count(*), sum(net_amount), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-03 00:00:00'
UNION ALL SELECT 'datemismatch_web', count(*), sum(net_amount), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_month_' || strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m'), count(*), sum(net_amount), min(sale_date), max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m')
UNION ALL SELECT 'fiscal_notloaded', count(*), 0, min(period_start_date), max(period_end_date) FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE NOT fully_loaded AND period_start_date>=DATE '2025-11-01'

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, p.sku, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = f.channel_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE c.channel_group = 'web' AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
),
sales AS (SELECT sku, sum(net_amount) AS sales_net FROM web_lines GROUP BY sku),
refunds AS (
  SELECT w.sku, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN web_lines w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id GROUP BY w.sku
),
names AS (SELECT sku, max(product_name) AS product_name FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku)
SELECT s.sku, n.product_name, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur
FROM sales s JOIN names n USING (sku) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sku)
ORDER BY s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net, 0) DESC LIMIT 12
